description: 400 LoRA SFT runs of Qwen2.5-0.5B on databricks-dolly-15k, 750 optimizer steps, validation cross-entropy on a frozen 500-example subset every 15 steps (50 evaluations). Each config is an i.i.d. draw from the frozen prior in docs/hyperparameter-prior.md. Runs are in (night_seed, draw) order, the order the pre-registered splits index into.
